title: 第十五章 和帝姬签订契约第十六章 至尊阶生死剑
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
白筱如想到了秦天的境界后，觉得答应这个契约，也不是不可以的。
只要自己努力修炼，要不了多久就能超过他的境界。
虽然这件事情会成为她一辈子的屈辱。
但是为了活命她也只能忍辱负重了。
“我答应。”
“但是你要保证，100年后或者境界超过你就解除契约。”
秦天自然知道她的想法，嘴角微微勾起一抹笑意，“我保证。”
随后秦天就开始勾勒系统传授给他的契约阵图。
没多久，阵图勾勒完成，上面还有不少神秘符文。
秦天割破手指，一滴精血滴入。
顿时，阵图光芒大盛，但是阵图的体积在变小。
到了拳头大小后，它就飞向了白筱如的脑门。
“不要反抗。”秦天提醒道。
白筱如咬着牙让阵图进入脑海中。
此时她感觉自己和秦天有了一种神秘的联系。
而且秦天的意志可以压制她。
叮！
【和青丘帝姬签订主仆契约任务完成。】
奖励至尊阶功法：天狐至尊决。
奖励极品帝宝：天狐珠，可以提升狐族的修炼速度，狐族的法术伤害翻倍。

奖励：所学所有武技提升一重。
契约完成的一刹那，秦天也得到了奖励。
前两项应该是给白筱如准备的。
后面的武技提升对于他来说也是挺不错的。
他在使用祖龙爪之内的武技，应该就十一重的了。
只可惜他的功法，他化自在大法。
以及炼体之术万古不灭体没有提升。
因为这两种是属于修炼功法体系，不是武技。
看着给白筱如准备的奖励。
秦天先拿出了至尊阶功法“天狐至尊决”递给白筱如。
“以后你就修炼这本功法吧，肯定比你狐族的功法好。”
“比我狐族功法还好？”白筱如一脸的不相信。
“我狐族功法九尾天经，可是帝阶功法中最顶尖的。”
“这世上能和我狐族功法想媲美的都没多少，更何况是超过。”
正在收拾的桌子的安妙菱笑了笑。
想当初她就是这样被打脸的。
“你看看不就知道了。”秦天提醒道。
白筱如半信半疑的开始翻看天狐至尊决。
content_en:
After Bai Xiaoru thought about Qin Tian's realm, she felt that it was not impossible to agree to this contract.
As long as you practice hard, you will be able to surpass his realm in no time.
Although this matter will be a lifelong humiliation for her.
But in order to survive, she had no choice but to endure the humiliation and bear the burden.
"I promise."
"But you have to promise that you will terminate the contract after 100 years or if your level exceeds yours."
Qin Tian naturally knew what she was thinking, and a smile appeared on his lips, "I promise."
Qin Tian then began to outline the contract formation map taught to him by the system.
Not long after, the formation diagram was completed, with many mysterious runes on it.
Qin Tian cut his finger and a drop of blood dripped into it.
Suddenly, the formation diagram glowed brightly, but the size of the formation diagram was getting smaller.
After it reached the size of a fist, it flew towards Bai Xiaoru's head.
"Don't resist." Qin Tian reminded.
Bai Xiaoru gritted her teeth and let the formation diagram enter her mind.
At this time, she felt that she had a mysterious connection with Qin Tian.
And Qin Tian's will can suppress her.
bite!
[The task of signing a master-servant contract with Emperor Qingqiu is completed. 】
Reward the supreme level skill: Tianhu Supreme Jue.
Reward the top-grade imperial treasure: Sky Fox Bead, which can increase the cultivation speed of the fox clan and double the damage of the fox clan's spells.
Reward: All martial arts learned will be improved by one level.
The moment the contract was completed, Qin Tian also received a reward.
The first two items should be prepared for Bai Xiaoru.
The subsequent improvement of martial arts is also quite good for him.
The martial arts he is using within the Ancestral Dragon Claw should be at the eleventh level.
It's a pity that his technique, his great method of transformation.
And the body refining technique, the eternal body, has not been improved.
Because these two types belong to the cultivation system, not martial arts.
Looking at the reward prepared for Bai Xiaoru.
Qin Tianxian took out the supreme level skill "Tianhu Supreme Jue" and handed it to Bai Xiaoru.
"You should practice this technique from now on. It will definitely be better than your fox clan's technique."
"Is it better than my fox clan's technique?" Bai Xiaoru said with a look of disbelief.
"My fox clan's Nine-Tailed Heavenly Scripture is the best among the emperor-level techniques."
"There aren't many people in the world who can compare with my fox clan's skills, let alone surpass them."
An Miaoling, who was clearing the table, smiled.
I think that was how she was slapped in the face.
"You'll know just by looking at it," Qin Tian reminded.
Bai Xiaoru began to look through the Tianhu Supreme Art with hesitation.
